انأطروا (form VII)
# اِنْأَطَرُوا (inʔaṭarū) /in.ʔa.tˤa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْأَطَرَ (inʔaṭara)
# اِنْأَطِرُوا (inʔaṭirū) /in.ʔa.tˤi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْأَطَرَ (inʔaṭara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
